title: UNDERSTANDING THE GEOSPATIAL REASONING CAPABILITIES OF LLMS: A TRAJECTORY RECOVERY PERSPECTIVE

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the trajectory recovery performance of LLMs across different geographic regions (e.g., Global North versus Global South) using Point-on-Trajectory and Mean Absolute Error metrics.

Evaluating and comparing model performance in reconstructing trajectories across different modes of transportation and activities (e.g., driving, cycling, walking, hiking, bus, train, boat, and flying).
